evidence: The ALD of PZT was performed using a substrate temperature of 250 /C14 C, using precursors lead bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5- heptanedionato) (Pb(C 11H19O2)2), titanium diisopropoxide bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5- heptanedionato) (Ti(OC3H7)2 (C11H19O2)2), and zirconium chloride (ZrCl 4) with H2O as the oxidant.
